channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: How US leaders remembered the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks
item.description: Trump drew parallels to the US's present-day war against Iran, while figures like Abdul El-Sayed called for inclusivity.

item.title: Houthi advance in Yemen is about more than just the Red Sea
item.description: Houthis were already able to disrupt shipping - their advance consolidates that power, and exposes government weakness.

item.title: Iran says will discuss Strait of Hormuz with Gulf states on Monday
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry says the meeting in Oman is to 'promote better understanding among the countries of the region'.

item.title: US holds memorials for the 9/11 attacks, 25 years later
item.description: In New York, Virginia and Pennsylvania, mourners gathered to remember nearly 3,000 people killed during the hijackings.

item.title: Houthis declare Red Sea shipping safe except for Saudi vessels
item.description: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said maritime navigation in the Red Sea is safe, except for Saudi ships.

item.title: Houthis take control of Yemen’s entire Red Sea coast, reports say
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthi forces have taken control over most of the western Red Sea coastal line

item.title: Can the Houthis close the Red Sea after seizing the Yemen coast?
item.description: Some observers see a force that has improved impressively in the past years, but others doubt the Houthis can sustain wins.

item.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are also reported to have seized Perim - a strategic island on the major shipping route.

item.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
item.description: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

item.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
item.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.
